title: BP vs Buckler 1987
outcome: Not held. Internal review requested 20 June 2026; no reply.

messages.summary: Request for records on BP Properties Ltd v Buckler (1987): 1988 letters from the constituency MP to the Lord Chancellor, the Lord Chancellor's Department's replies, and internal records on the case, Great House Farm and the eviction.
Automated receipt from the MoJ Disclosure Team mailbox: FOI response expected within 20 working days.
messages.body_public:
This is an automated confirmation that your email has been received by the
Disclosure Team (Ministry of Justice) mailbox. Please be aware, this team
deals with a high volume of emails.
Please note this email address is for requests for recorded information
under the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and non-offender subject
access requests under Data Protection Act 2018 (DPA)/General Data
Protection Regulation (GDPR).
Freedom of Information requests
You can expect a response within 20 working days.
Subject Access Requests
You can expect an initial response within 1 calendar month.
Any other types of queries/requests, will be handled accordingly.

messages.summary: Response FOI 250628005 (letter attached): no information held. Searches for the 1988 MP correspondence returned nothing; the only record held is the published Court of Appeal judgment; the Lord Chancellor's Department's 1988 policy records would have been destroyed under retention rules.
